title: Size a checkpoint by what it takes to explain
statement: As an architect I can see whether a checkpoint is reviewable, judged by whether Change Saga could explain it in five or six slides rather than ten to twenty

acceptance_criteria.statement: plan guide estimates a checkpoint's size from the number of stories and Tasks it holds, and names one that looks to need more than six slides without refusing it
A checkpoint's review reports how many slides it took, beside what the Plan estimated
